name: Rapport
summary: A sales CRM for a rooftop solar installer, with a roof-to-revenue funnel and a win-rate map of the town
about: A nine-page CRM for Sunmoor Solar, a small firm that fits panels on homes and businesses. Deals travel as dots through a roof-to-revenue funnel from survey to switch-on, and a map of the town's neighbourhoods shows where roofs say yes. Pipeline, customers, tasks, areas, team, project and profile pages all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Dashboard, Pipeline, Customers, Tasks, Areas, Team or Settings, or a project or crew member
Watch deals travel through the roof-to-revenue funnel, then click a panel to jump to that stage in the pipeline
Drag deal cards between columns, or use a card's menu to move, edit or delete it
Click a customer to open the drawer: change the stage, check the roof and payback numbers, add notes
Switch the area map between win rate, leads and kW, and click a neighbourhood for its details
Add tasks and milestones, tick them off, and edit a project's budget
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, and reset the demo data in Settings
